attack_plan.narrative: In the late afternoon, reports from the European capital suggest an unusual activity at the Kremlin, where white smoke has been observed. This unexplained occurrence has led to speculation about Putin's whereabouts and well-being. In the meantime, there are unverified reports of Putin's close associate going into labor, which has raised further questions about his presence and involvement. The absence of official statements from the Kremlin, combined with recent geopolitical tensions, has heightened concerns among international observers. Meanwhile, the Kremlin has released a new photo of Putin and Kim, showing them both doing well, though the timing and context of the release remain unclear. These developments have prompted the State Department to closely monitor the situation, indicating potential instability within the Kremlin.
